name: dd-collective-design
title_zh: 照着品牌手册长出来的界面，连原型都带正版色板
tagline_zh: 给 D+D Collective 做界面和资产，不用再翻 Figma 找色值。设计规范、字体。
tagline_en: Stop hunting hex codes in Figma. Design tokens, fonts, and UI kit are baked in—so every prototype already looks.
desc_en: Use this skill to generate well-branded interfaces and assets for D+D Collective, either for production or throwaway prototypes/mocks/etc. Contains essential design guidelines, colors, type, fonts, assets, and UI kit components for protoyping.
why_zh: 把设计系统直接塞进 skill 上下文，生成时自动对齐品牌规范，而不是靠模型猜。
why_en: Design system lives in the skill context, so outputs align to brand specs by default—no guessing. Prototypes and finals share.
limit_zh: 只认 D+D Collective 一家品牌，换别的项目得自己改色板和字体文件。产出是设计稿和资产，不含前端代码。
limit_en: D+D Collective brand only; other projects need custom tokens. Outputs are design assets, not code. Requires access to repo design resources.
title_en: Brand-faithful UI and assets for D+D Collective, from mock.
